text:
anna_marketing: Quick update — we're moving the benchmark post publish window 30m later. New publish target 10:30 PST (embargo 11:30 UTC). Reason: last-minute metric re-audit. Need ops to hold any scheduled purges until I say go. Assets are the same: https://drive.redwood/inference/benchmarks/pack_v2.zip. @josh_ops can you confirm no automatic jobs will run at 10:00 now?
josh_ops: Copy. I'll pause the CDN purge job and reschedule prewarm to T-25m before 10:30. Found one origin rule mismatch in staging that could strip query params for widget embeds  I'll push a fix to staging and run a smoke at T-40m.
cecilia_pm: Legal asked for one tweak to the wording around the latency sample size. @karen_legal can you sign off on the revised stat sentence? I updated the doc: https://docs.redwood/benchmarks/notes_v2.
karen_legal: Reviewing now. If we keep the phrasing "measured across representative deployments" we're fine. I'll add a short caveat for the press note.
sam_engineering: Heads-up from infra: our synthetic load tests at 09:00 PST showed a spike in 95p token time when batch size rolled up. I'm going to lock batching to 8 for the canary shards during the first 20 minutes post-publish. Means slightly higher cost but safer.
press_bot: Press embargo list amended. 3 contacts asked for a 1-hour heads-up call at publish time. I've added them as phone numbers in the matrix. Reminder: embargo recipients flagged with (E).
lisa_seo: If slug changes to /benchmarks/apr-2026 we need redirects in place. @josh_ops can you add the redirect rule to the CDN config when you push fixes? Also will swap OG at T-15m.
evan_support: I'll stitch a short internal FAQ doc and pin to #support-bench. Also request someone from eng to be on the pager for 30m post-publish for quick clarifications.
anna_marketing: Quick manual checklist update (paste into launch doc):
```
- New publish: 10:30 PST / embargo 11:30 UTC
- T-60m: Final legal + assets lock
- T-40m: Staging smoke, batch lock + CDN redirect push
- T-25m: CDN prewarm (ops)
- T-15m: OG image swap, canonical, social queue final
- T-5m: Rate-limit rules apply; pager assigned
- Publish: flip live, press email send
- T+10m: verify error rates & ingestion; scale rules if needed
- T+30m: rollback temp rules; compile incident notes if any
```
anna_marketing: Can everyone react with :eyes: if ready or comment with blockers. I'll run the final preflight at 09:55 PST. Thanks all!
